node.title: L1 joint Plotkin-boundary payment
node.statement: Encode each exact-support contributor by A=D disjoint_union R in the (N+b)-point core/background universe, where R is a canonical u-subset of its background agreements. The shared cross-determinant budget gives |A triangle A'|>=2ell. If N+b<=4ell, the sign-vector embeddings have pairwise nonpositive inner products, so the elementary Rankin bound gives at most 2(N+b)<=2n contributors. Thus fixed petal polarity is polynomial throughout the equality regime and every live cell satisfies N+b>4ell. For an official rate-1/r source this is equivalent to rb>(4(r-1)-M)ell+r, or (M-3(r-1)+1)ell>r(g+1).
